project.ItemDescriptionShort: Compatibility patch for SWF and 24-slot inventory UI
project.Title: SWF + 24 Inventory Compatibility Patch
project.ItemDescription:
Restores a 24-slot inventory, 24-slot provision bag, and 8 trinket slots while keeping SWF enabled.
Load this after: - SWF (V0.25) - 2goals, QOL, mermaids, sandwiches... - Trinkets 8, 24 Inventory, 10 Quirks
